title: Scene Plan
description: Shot-by-shot plan produced by the production pipeline's scene_plan stage (and by templates/scene-plan-from-vague-brief.md). Read by qa/slideshow-risk.py before compose, and by the generator/editor adapters to render. One inspectable file per job: ${VIDEO_JOBS_DIR}/<brief_id>/scene_plan.json

subject.description: Who/what is on screen. For multi-clip consistency this is the Lock Block target (see brand/consistency-rules.md).

action.description: What happens in the shot - the narrative intent

camera_move.description: static / pan / tilt / push-in / pull-out / dolly / handheld / orbit / ken-burns / crane / whip

lighting.description: Lighting recipe (e.g. Rembrandt, golden hour, neon, soft key)

audio.description: Diegetic sound / VO / music intent for this shot

narration.description: Optional voiceover line spoken over this shot

on_screen_text.description: Caption / title / lower-third text burned on this shot

asset_kind.description: Where the visual comes from. 'image' and 'title_card' are still by default and must declare a camera_move (e.g. ken-burns) to count as motion.

source_ref.description: For broll/footage: clip_id or file path (e.g. from broll-manifest.json)
